name: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
notes: Param count 3821079552 from safetensors metadata is IDENTICAL to Phi-3 mini, and every geometry field matches (hidden 3072, 32 layers, 32 KV heads, intermediate 8192, vocab 32064) — verified field-by-field against both config.json files. head_dim derived = 3072 / 32 = 96. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 32 * 32 * 96 * 2 * 2 = 24576 bytes/token at bf16, same as Phi-3 mini. The one change is context: max_position_embeddings 131072 with original_max_position_embeddings 4096 and a LongRoPE-style extension, plus sliding_window raised from 2047 to 262144 which effectively disables block sparsity. That matters for serving: at the advertised 128k context this model holds 128k * 24576 B = 3.0 GiB of KV per sequence, which is more than a 4-bit copy of the weights. Anyone quoting the 128k window without quoting the KV cost is quoting half the model. Phi-3.5-mini has NO separate rope_scaling object in config.json (LongRoPE is baked into the released weights); context_scaling 'LongRoPE' is stated by Microsoft's model card, not by config.json — treat that one field as card-derived. Official ONNX and GGUF ports exist, including onnx-community/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-ONNX-GQA.
